name: AI-Writer
tagline: AI-Writer generates full-length blog articles from a headline with cited sources, SEO analysis, and a verifiable AI text indicator. Unlike many AI writers that hallucinate, AI-Writer grounds its content in real web sources and provides footnotes for every claim, making it suitable for factual content production.
